items.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
items.snippet: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.
items.note: Позитивний тон для SOL за ключовими словами.

items.title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
items.snippet: ZachXBT says he infiltrated the network by posing as a customer, gaining information that helped trace funds from the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
